name: pipeline_watchdog_live_lane_skip_20261109
comment: rows predate the n8n cutover, so a lane with dispatch.mode live had a second scheduler:
pipeline_watchdog retried the script outside the coordination ledger, without the lane's
lock, from the dev checkout (incubator-llm-screener ran twice on 2026-11-09). The watchdog
now skips any row a live-dispatched lane owns, matching on the script AND the lane's flags
(news-ingestion-tail runs --tail-rotate live; the un-flagged priority row stays checked).
A malformed dispatch block parses to off and stays checked; an unreadable registry fails
closed for the whole cycle. Tests are hermetic: synthetic registry, no DB, no subprocess.
